meta.name: Call My Agent Bollywood 720p
meta.description: From pulling off casting coups to calming celebrity egos, the drama never stops for four Mumbai talent agents hustling to save their sinking company.

videos.title: Ticket to Hollywood
videos.overview: Talent agent Mehershad panics over telling celebrity client Dia Mirza the truth about a coveted film deal. An office visitor catches Monty off guard.

videos.title: In Loving Memory
videos.overview: Mehershad and Amal clash as they put nemeses Lillete Dubey and Ila Arun up for the same role. A tragedy puts the agency’s future in question.

videos.title: Casting Coup
videos.overview: Mehershad and Monty offer feuding mom and daughter Sarika and Akshara Haasan the same script. Amal makes a bold attempt to distract a tax auditor.

videos.title: Tax Notice
videos.overview: Monty pulls strings to get cash-strapped actress Lara Dutta a role, and faces heat from the team when they learn what he’s been keeping from them

videos.title: Break Up and Make Up
videos.overview: On location with bickering couple Richa Chadda and Ali Fazal, Amal and Mehershad are in for surprises. Business becomes increasingly personal for Monty.

videos.title: In the Dog House
videos.overview: Amal's love life nosedives as she mediates a fallout between director Nandita Das and actor Jackie Shroff. Monty’s past catches up to the firm’s future.
